## What changes and why

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by:` line (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] The build has no warnings, and the unit tests and CTest tests pass.
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_doc_links.py --fix` ran and its changes are included.
- [ ] A port change links the `docs/re/` evidence, or is listed as a stand-in.
- [ ] No game assets, saves, traces or memory dumps. No local paths or machine details.
- [ ] I did not change progress files, `docs/plans/features/id-reservations.md`, generated files, plan gates, `docs/design/` or `.claude/`.
- [ ] A new or grown file over 100 KB under `tests/data/` has a reason below, and holds recorded values with their source.

This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Nintendo or any other right holder of the game.
